answer: Mechanism: randomized admission interviews. Joining needs a resampled quorum of established members to interview the applicant over whisper channels. Interviewers check work samples plus an opal-violet signature binding replies to one key, so an operator cannot clone one performance across puppets. Attacker cost: each puppet pays each sampled interviewer a flat fee, no bulk booking, and each interviewer takes at most k sessions per epoch, so N seats cost N quorum fees growing with N; an honest applicant books one quorum, pays once.
